name: artifact
content:
1. Explicit: name already has valid extension → use directly
2. Shebang: #!/usr/bin/env python → .py; #!/usr/bin/env node → .js
3. Lang hint + content: lang='typescript' + "class AuthHandler {" → auth-handler.ts
4. Content fingerprint: matches TypeScript patterns → .ts; SQL patterns → .sql; etc
5. Context mention: surrounding message contains "reconnect.ts" → use that name
6. MIME type: text/typescript → .ts
7. Fallback: {provider}-artifact-{sha1-8chars}.{lang-ext-or-txt}

name: artifact
content:
gap-finder detects gap
    │
    ▼ gaps insert (status='open')
    │
gap-context-injector polls gaps (every 3s)
    │
    ├── no existing gap_question for this gap UUID?
    │       YES → generate question from taxonomy
    │             → gap_questions insert (status='pending')
    │             → event_log: 'gap.question.generated'
    │             → toast.gap RED with "nexus gap show <uuid>" action
    │
callto dispatches next agent_call
    │
    ├── _loadOptionalModules() → lazy-require gap-context-injector
    │
    ├── buildInjectionBlock(callUuid, { limit: 3 })
    │       → queries gap_questions WHERE status='pending'
    │       → sorts by priority (critical→high→medium→low), then age
    │       → marks selected as status='injected', injectedInto=callUuid
    │       → returns SYSTEM CONTEXT block string (or null if no questions)
    │
    ├── finalPrompt = [gap context block] + [primary request]
    │
    ├── POSTs to Guardian /api/complete with finalPrompt
    │
    ▼ agent responds
    │
    ├── parseAndRecordAnswers(callUuid, responseText)
    │       → regex: /GAP ANSWER (\d+): .../
    │       → marks answered questions as status='answered', answer=...
    │       → questions with no answer: reset to status='pending'
    │       → event_log: 'gap.question.answered'
    │
gap-context-injector tick (next cycle)
    │
    ├── processes answered questions
    │       → writes answer to memory_index (tier='failure', healer reads it)
    │       → writes to fix_map if answer is actionable
    │       → marks question status='resolved'
    │       → event_log: 'gap.question.resolved'
    │       → toast.success GREEN
